title: Sales Consultant
description:
About Us

Established 20 years ago, Phi Partners is a global technology services consultancy based out of London with an annualized turnover of £50m.

We operate exclusively within capital markets, in the front office, pricing and risk space, covering both business and technology services. With six lines of business, four international hubs and five international delivery centres, Phi has become a leading global financial markets IT services provider within our niche domains. We have over 500 consultants supporting more than 80 financial institutions around the world.

Our international sales team run out of Wrotham Business Park in London where we have over 30 sales consultants covering the broad range of business lines, clients and geographies. This team includes junior sales personnel who focus primarily on candidate research and recruitment whilst they are being trained to become client-facing sales consultants and eventually account managers. We are now expanding out Sales & Research team to include a team in our São Paulo office!

Phi offers our clients a comprehensive range of services including staff augmentation, advisory, project and managed services. These deals range from £100,000 to £20,000,000 in size, creating huge revenue and earnings opportunities.

Role and Career Opportunities

Phi has an ongoing commitment to growth in terms of client acquisition, geographical reach, and evolution of our lines of business and service catalogue. To support our ambitions, we take on four cohorts of junior sales consultants each year, in January, April, July, and October. Each consultant is trained the “Phi way”.

We are looking for talent who are either fresh out of university or in the early stages of their careers. Subject to meeting reasonable competency and performance targets, you can expect regular opportunities for advancement throughout your journey:

  • In the first 6 months you will be in our London Office being trained by our leadership team.
  • Initially, you will focus on candidate research and recruitment. After six months, you will be allocated to a line of business, allowing you to become a specialist recruiter within that field. Training that is specific to the line of business will allow you to master your ability to converse confidently with client and internal specialists.
  • After a period of between 12-18 months, you can expect to begin your move into client-facing sales. You will be allocated a small number of clients specific to your line of business, beginning your journey with client research, leading into full client engagement if the client is approved as a target.
  • Once you have closed deals with clients (bringing master services agreements between the client and Phi), you will begin to generate P&L. Subject to competency and revenue targets, you will complete your move into sales. We expect this phase to take between 18-24 months, and you will be supported on your journey by more senior sales leads, a deal architecture / pre-sales team, and the subject-matter-experts from within the delivery teams.
  • As a fully-fledged sales consultant, you will be part of a smaller group of 10, that are some of the best in the world. You will manage your client portfolio and may be given an expanded scope of clients giving you the room to really become a true success. Depending on results, you may be allocated one or two strategic key accounts, with the greatest potential for growth. These accounts are global, and relevant for multiple lines of business. They will bring a large portfolio, driving significant P&L and earnings.

Our most successful salespeople will make Partner at Phi, giving access to stock in the company that is granted annually based on a transparent assessment of contribution. Within the sales team we have three partners today, all of whom came through the graduate program, and we except two more to get promoted in 2025. The sky is the limit at Phi for the most ambitions and driven!

What we are looking for

Commitment and drive

We are looking for highly motivated individuals with a strong desire to succeed, and who are prepared to do “whatever it takes”. We are looking for problem solvers who have the ability to “find a way” to solve any challenge; people who won’t give up when the going gets tough! To become successful, it will take a long time to develop the required skills to be independent and to operate autonomously. So, we are looking for people who are truly committed and driven. These are all skills that you will have had life-long, applied and improved over many years. We will be looking to understand what drives you at a fundamental level, as this is what you will rely on to succeed.

Communication and charisma

Our sales consultants must be great communicators: people who have natural confidence with person-to-person communication, from over-the-phone interactions to directing meetings with senior stakeholders. You will need to be charismatic and confident. An ability to develop meaningful and relationships built on respect and trust is critical.

Team spirit

At Phi we have maintained a “small company” mindset and feel, with an excellent team spirit – we work together, we socialize together, we support each other. Our appreciation for the wider Phi community makes us stronger than the sum of our parts. We are looking for people who will naturally be at home as part of a strong team – who can understand our values, contribute to the wider Phi community, share knowledge, and put the team before themselves. We will be looking for evidence of this, academically, professionally, or outside (such as sport).

Life at Phi

Phi is an established business but feels like a start-up, specially being part of our brand-new team in Brazil. Your base will be in São Paulo, but as you develop into client-facing sales, you will spend time out of the office and will have opportunities for regular international travel.

Our family mentality means that even the most junior at Phi has access to the senior leadership team. We are approachable. You will be on first name terms with the CRO and CEO. Beyond the sales team, you will work within a wider community across pre-sales and delivery, specific to your clients and your line-of-business.

Our company thrives in having a diverse and international staff and this is especially true in our London office, where the Sales & Research team is located. Our sales consultants come from all parts of the world and there is a vibrant and youthful atmosphere. The atmosphere is dynamic and busy (punctual starts and hard work are inevitable), but always friendly. We socialize regularly outside office hours. Many of the senior team members at Phi have known each other for decades, and people who are the right fit for Phi can expect to build friendships that will last a lifetime. The goal is to build a similar environment in our new operation in Brazil!

Training and Reward

You can expect initial and ongoing training, in a well-designed, competency-based framework with a comprehensive and growing learning and development library. You can expect to be carefully performance-managed using our proprietary tools, ensuring that your contributions are fairly measured and that you are supported in your drive to succeed in any areas that need developing.

We offer competitive salaries and the best commission structure in the market. We have a simple and straightforward commission model that rewards you for what you generate. With no caps, your earning potential is unlimited.

title: Analista de contabilidade sênior

title: Public Relations Manager - LATAM
description:
About Cooler Master

Cooler Master is a global computer hardware manufacturer founded in 1992 in Taiwan. The company is known for its award-winning PC components, including cases, power supplies, cooling solutions, and accessories.

In addition to retail product lines, Cooler Master also serves as an OEM partner to major technology brands worldwide. The company has grown steadily through a strong focus on innovation, design, and user-driven product development. Headquartered in Taipei, Cooler Master operates manufacturing facilities in China and maintains regional offices across the globe.

Role Overview

Lead public relations for Latin America (LATAM) to elevate Cooler Master’s visibility across key markets such as Brazil, Mexico, Argentina, and Chile.

You’ll manage PR execution for launches and ongoing brand activations—aligning local media, translating technical information into engaging stories, and ensuring consistent communication with global and regional marketing teams.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the LATAM PR Plan – Develop and execute the regional PR calendar and embargo plan; ensure alignment with global launches and LATAM sales priorities.
  • Build Media Relationships – Cultivate strong connections with top-tier tech and gaming editors, reviewers, and influencers across Portuguese and Spanish-speaking markets.
  • Host Press Briefings & Events – Lead virtual and local events; manage press lists, invitations, materials, and post-event follow-ups.
  • Coordinate Product Reviews – Manage the sample allocation, delivery, and follow-up process with regional media outlets.
  • Partner Collaboration – Drive joint PR opportunities with distributors, e-commerce partners, and brand collaborators.
  • Content Localization – Adapt global press materials for LATAM audiences to ensure cultural and linguistic accuracy.
  • Monitor & Report – Track press coverage, analyze media performance metrics, and deliver post-launch summaries.
  • Maintain Compliance – Ensure consistent application of embargoes, NDA terms, and authorized content usage.

Qualifications

  • Education : Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Communications, Journalism, Marketing, or related field.
  • Experience : 5–8+ years in tech, consumer electronics, or gaming PR across LATAM. Proven track record in media relations and launch management.
  • Regional Expertise :
  • Strong understanding of LATAM media ecosystem and regional communication styles.
  • Existing relationships with major tech and gaming outlets.
  • Language Skills :
  • Fluent in English and either Portuguese or Spanish (bilingual proficiency preferred).
  • Execution & Measurement :
  • Strong organizational skills, ability to manage multiple launches.
  • Familiarity with PR metrics such as share of voice and media reach.

Who You Are

  • A proactive communicator with high accountability and attention to detail.
  • Skilled at relationship-building across diverse markets and cultures.
  • Confident managing embargoes, timelines, and media expectations.
  • Adaptable and independent, yet collaborative with global teammates.

Descrição da vaga

Você conhece a Sany do Brasil? Fundada em 1989 em Changsha, na China, o Grupo Sany dedica-se à produção de máquinas pesadas, tendo como principais produtos as máquinas para construção civil, pavimentação, escavação, reach stacker, guindastes, máquinas portuárias e de mineração.

Há 20 anos, o Grupo Sany tem conquistado progresso e sucesso na sua jornada. Possui dez fábricas na China, uma na Índia, uma na Alemanha e uma nos Estados Unidos, além de aplicar políticas agressivas como a de dedicar 5% de seu faturamento anual em pesquisa e desenvolvimento de novas tecnologias. Como parte da sua estratégia de crescimento, em 2012, a Sany adquiriu a empresa alemã Putzmeister. A união das áreas de negócios da Sany e da Putzmeister formou o maior líder mundial da área de equipamentos para concreto.

Atualmente, a Sany emprega cerca de 40 mil colaboradores em mais de 150 países. No Brasil, a trajetória do Grupo Sany iniciou em 2007, quando atuava como importador de equipamentos. O ano de 2011 marcou a consolidação do Grupo no país, com o anúncio de investimentos da ordem de US$ 200 milhões. Em janeiro do mesmo ano, a Sany inaugurou na cidade de São José dos Campos, interior de São Paulo, sua primeira unidade fabril para montagem de escavadeiras e guindastes sobre caminhão no regime de CKD (Completely Knock-Down), em uma área total de 30 mil m². Em 2012 a Sany recebeu da Fundação Carlos Alberto Vanzolini a certificação de qualidade ISO 9001:2008, garantindo o rigoroso processo de qualidade e segurança da empresa. E

m 2013, visando uma nova etapa de crescimento, a Sany iniciou a montagem dos guindastes RT (rough terrain) e dos rolos compactadores na sua unidade fabril. No final de 2017, inauguramos as nossas instalações na cidade de Jacareí/SP. A Sany possui uma rede de distribuidores e filiais próprias pronta para oferecer seus produtos e excelentes serviços de pós-vendas em todas as regiões do país.

Como nosso Gerente de Vendas, você irá:

  • Ser responsável pelo desenvolvimento de mercado e pela implementação da estratégia de marketing para o negócio de microgrids no Brasil;
  • Coordenar os recursos locais, promover a implementação de projetos e ser responsável pelo acompanhamento da operação e gestão;
  • Colaborar com departamentos internos e externos para avaliar e determinar a viabilidade de soluções técnicas;
  • Reportar regularmente sobre o progresso dos negócios regionais, analisar a dinâmica do mercado e propor recomendações estratégicas de otimização.

Requisitos para que possa se juntar ao nós:

  • Ensino superior completo;
  • Experiência anterior com vendas no setor de microgrids;
  • Inglês avançado;
  • Excelentes habilidades de trabalho em equipe e comunicação intercultural, com capacidade de adaptação a ambientes de trabalho diversos.

Você usufruirá dos seguintes benefícios:

  • Assistência Médica

  • Seguro de Vida
  • Vale Refeição
  • Transporte
  • Crédito Consignado
  • Ticket Mês Aniversário

A posição envolve a elaboração de propostas técnicas e comerciais, além de estabelecer comunicação com outros departamentos para viabilizar ofertas competitivas.

Responsabilidades

  • Elaborar propostas técnicas e comerciais visando sempre a melhor relação custo x benefício a fim de obter uma oferta mais competitiva de serviços, soluções, produtos e peças de Qualidade do Ar, Meteorologia e Hidrologia;
  • Estabelecer interface e comunicação direta com outros departamentos e colaboradores internos com o objetivo de viabilizar a oferta técnica e solução competitivas;
  • Realizar a análise e abertura de pedidos de venda, incluindo o acompanhamento das oportunidades em sistema interno;
  • Treinar e oferecer suporte os colaboradores da área;
  • Estabelecer interface direta com fábricas, fornecedores e parceiros internacionais e locais visando obter esclarecimentos técnicos relativos aos produtos especificados, bem como a obtenção de preços para posterior formação do preço;
  • Identificar oportunidades de ampliação de contratos e vendas de novos produtos e serviços de clientes existentes;
  • Manter suas oportunidades, clientes e contatos sempre atualizados no CRM (Salesforce e Omie) da empresa;
  • Participar ativamente no planejamento comercial e na elaboração dos planos de ação;
  • Fornecer atualizações regulares sobre atividades, previsão de vendas, progresso de demonstrações e status de ações de vendas.

Qualificações

  • Graduação em Engenharia Ambiental, Engenharia Química, Química ou áreas correlatas.

Habilidades Necessárias

  • Experiência em vendas técnicas e elaboração de propostas voltadas à monitoramento da qualidade do ar e meteorologia.
  • Vivência com CRM, preferencialmente Salesforce.
  • Inglês avançado (para contato com as fábricas e treinamentos).
  • Disponibilidade para viagens esporádicas (visitas, apresentações e treinamentos em clientes a nível nacional).

Habilidades Preferenciais

  • Desejável conhecimento em instrumentação analítica, qualidade do ar e/ou equipamentos de meteorologia e hidrologia;
  • Residência no Rio de Janeiro ou região da Baixada.

Competências Comportamentais

  • Comunicação estruturada;
  • Proatividade e planejamento;
  • Foco no resultado e no cliente;
  • Capacidade analítica para entendimento de necessidades técnicas;
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e relacionamento interpessoal.

title: Pessoa Desenvolvedora Back-End Java - Sênior
description:
Descrição da vaga

A FCamara está em busca de uma Pessoa Desenvolvedora Back-End Java Sênior, em parceria com uma das maiores empresas de solução digital, voltada ao e-commerce que tem atuação em mais de 60 anos de história, com mais de 1.000 lojas físicas, 28 centros de distribuição e mais de 33 milhões de produtos no marketplace.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Desenvolvimento e manutenção de APIs RESTful robustas e escaláveis utilizando Java e Spring Boot.
  • Implementação de soluções de mensageria com Apache Kafka.

  • Experiência com desenvolvimento e consumo de APIs RESTful.
  • Conhecimento em mensageria com Apache Kafka.

  • Proficiência em bancos de dados relacionais (SQL Server) e não relacionais (MongoDB).

title: Analista de Controladoria
description:
Vaga: Analista de Controladoria 

Local: Sinop

Se você é analítico, organizado e gosta de transformar dados em decisões estratégicas, essa vaga é para você!

Sobre a vaga

O Analista de Controladoria será responsável por garantir a confiabilidade das informações gerenciais e apoiar a alta gestão na tomada de decisões estratégicas, através da análise de desempenho, controle orçamentário, validação de indicadores e acompanhamento de resultados financeiros e operacionais.

Principais responsabilidades:

  • Elaborar, revisar e acompanhar o orçamento empresarial anual.
  • Consolidar e analisar indicadores de desempenho financeiro e operacional.
  • Apoiar a diretoria na tomada de decisões estratégicas com base em dados confiáveis.
  • Realizar análises de variações orçamentárias (real x previsto) e propor ações corretivas.
  • Monitorar custos, receitas, margens e rentabilidade por unidade de negócio.
  • Desenvolver relatórios gerenciais e dashboards.
  • Atuar em conjunto com áreas contábil, fiscal, jurídico, operações e comercial.

Requisitos:

  • Graduação em Administração, Economia, Ciências Contábeis ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência em controladoria, planejamento financeiro ou áreas afins.
  • Excel avançado e conhecimento em ERP.
  • Desejável: Power BI e pós-graduação em Controladoria, Finanças ou Gestão Empresarial.

title: Director of Purchasing
description:
Autoliv, the global leader in automotive safety, is seeking a Director of Purchasing to lead our Brazil procurement function.

What you’ll lead:

  • Sourcing Strategy: Define and execute category strategies (direct & indirect), experience in leading global and local sourcing, ensure supply continuity, dual sourcing where needed, and deliver savings while safeguarding quality, delivery and cash (payment terms, inventory).
  • Supplier Partnership Development: Build high-performing supplier networks; drive VAVE, technical negotiations.
  • Financial Performance: Productivities year-over-year, inflation/economics and raw material negotiations, headwinds mitigation
  • Risk Management: Resourcing, capacity, geo & compliance.
  • Program & Cross-Functional Leadership: Partner with Engineering, Program Management, Sales, Quality, Logistics, Finance and Legal to source new programs on time (APQP/PPAP readiness), support launches, and resolve constraints quickly.
  • Performance & Governance: Lead the purchasing team with clear KPIs; enforce ethical standards and alignment with IATF/ESG and corporate policies; define local and enforce compliance to global corporate processes.

What makes you a strong fit:

  • 10+ years in OEM/Tier-1 automotive purchasing, with proven team leadership and results in complex, high-volume operations.
  • Bachelor’s degree (Engineering, Business, or related areas); MBA is a plus.
  • Mastery in negotiations, category management, cost modeling, and supplier performance management (APQP/PPAP familiarity).
  • Team Play: Partner with all functions to look for the best source solution considering Total Cost scenario, while driving high Quality Standards, associated to Stable and Predictable Deliveries.
  • Fluent English: Spanish is a plus

title: Merchant Material Supply Specialist
description:
About Us：

Keeta , the international subsidiary of Meituan—the global delivery giant—is on a mission to revolutionize food and consumer product delivery worldwide. With our core belief: " We help people eat better, live better, " we're taking innovation to the global stage! Within just one year, Keeta has become an industry leader in Hong Kong. With our ongoing expansions into Saudi Arabia, Keeta achieved the remarkable feat of launching 5 cities in just 17 days, allowing the Arab world to witness the speed of China! Keeta offers exciting opportunities to join a transformative journey that is shaping the future of delivery and retail. Join Keeta, explore the world.

Know more: Keeta website

What You'll Do:

  1. Responsible for collecting information, tracking the process, and final delivery of all merchant material procurement in Brazil . Ensure all required materials are delivered accurately, timely, and safely.
  2. Timely identify risk points in the material procurement process and communicate with multiple business parties to eliminate risks promptly.
  3. Maintain close communication with the BD team and merchants , and continuously optimize the overall material process based on customer feedback.

What We Need From You:

  1. Have product operation experience . Familiar with the standard internal processes from product development, product operation, to product iteration.
  2. Familiar with the merchant-side operations of e-commerce platforms . Priority given to those with experience in the food delivery industry. Priority given to those familiar with merchant metric operations.
  3. Possess in-depth knowledge of the daily operations of Brazilian food delivery merchants, or be able to collaborate with various internal teams to identify merchants' operational needs and pain points.
  4. Excellent communication and cross-team collaboration skills.
  5. Can use Portuguese and English as working languages.

What Make This Role Exciting:

  1. Early-stage business: Opportunity to participate in the initial planning, design, and implementation of key projects.
  2. International team: Work with members from 26 countries and experience a diverse work environment.

title: Ruby on Rails Developer
description:

You are a back-end engineer passionate about building scalable, reliable, and maintainable applications. description:
Acreditamos que um time diverso é mais capaz de gerar valor e ser resiliente, por isso nossas vagas estão abertas para todas as pessoas. Vem ser Iguatemi! A Iguatemi Empresa de Shopping Centers S.A. é uma das maiores empresas full service no setor de shopping centers do Brasil. Suas atividades englobam a concepção, o planejamento, o desenvolvimento e a administração de shopping centers regionais, outlets e complexos imobiliários de uso misto com torres comerciais. A Iguatemi detém participação em 15 shopping centers, 2 Premium Outlets e 4 torres comerciais. As ações da Iguatemi estão listadas no Novo Mercado da B3 (IGTI11) e fazem parte do índice Ibovespa. Nossa missão é criar experiências únicas e memoráveis a todos os nossos clientes.

⛳ MISSÃO DO CARGO

Responsável por conduzir os processos da cadeia de compra das coleções e acompanhamento dos indicadores da área de produto, como OTB, compras, vendas, cash flow, margem, Sell Thru e loss end. Garantir a correta precificação e alocação de produtos na loja, bem como treinamento de equipe e analise de mercado. Ter contato direto com a loja e demais áreas que possuem interação para garantir o alinhamento 360° em relação a produto e a otimização da venda/giro.

Responsável pela movimentação de peças nos diferentes estoque (inclusive entre lojas da mesma marca), garantindo a acuracidade da oferta em cada canal.

Responsável pela interface com o Iguatemi365, no tange os KPIs da área: oferta, precificação, disponibilidade de produtos, giro, venda por produto.

OBSERVAÇÕES

  • Conhecimentos técnicos sólidos em Excel (ser avançado é mandatório);
  • Inglês avançado é mandatório;
  • Formação: Administração, Marketing, Engenharia, Economia, e áreas correlatas;
  • Conhecimentos:
  • Conhecimentos de consumidor e tendências de comportamento;
  • Conhecimentos técnicos elementares em moda e mercado de luxo;

RESPONSABILIDADES PRINCIPAIS - O quê e como ?

  • Realizar a concepção do OTB (open to buy) diante da projeção e vendas determinada, considerando marca, coleções, categorias, subcategorias, itens, grade. Para acuracidade, deve considerar analise de histórico e tendências;
  • Realizar o processo de compra de produtos. Receber material da nova coleção, entender a inspiração junto a marca, analisar vendas e definir qual será o investimento de cada categoria (+subcategoria, itens, grade). Avaliar tendências e integrar equipe de varejo na definição dos produtos;
  • Realizar a precificação de produtos em linha com as premissas definidas e alinhadas com a marca e internamente determinadas pela iRetail. Sugerir as premissas adequadas para cada marca e momento, para tanto é necessário entender o mercado, analisar concorrência, para garantir que atingiremos os resultados definidos em budget;
  • Estar frequentemente em loja para acompanhar as vendas dos produtos junto à equipe de loja (in loco na loja), tanto quanti quanto qualitativamente, avaliar a exposição dos mesmos, reforçar o treinamento da equipe sobre a marca e os produtos. Propor sugestões de ações internas para melhoria do giro dos produtos (KPI); conectar frequentemente com Varejo e Marketing para discutir oportunidade e viabilidade das ações. Proatividade na busca de soluções para melhor girar produto;
  • Acompanhar o mercado de varejo, como ações e preços de concorrentes. Fazer uma análise crítica com relação ao que estamos praticando e, se necessário, propor mudanças;
  • Responsável pelo conhecimento das informações relacionadas a produto, assim como o treinamento da equipe. Garantir o conhecimento de todos os envolvidos no prazo necessário para que consigam agir em suas respectivas áreas;
  • Conhecer as clientes das marcas sob sua responsabilidade (grau de relacionamento de acordo com a tipo de cliente, as principais clientes precisa conhecer pessoalmente, ter relacionamento);
  • Garantir junto a área de Operações o recebimento dos produtos nos prazos necessários. Acompanhar todos os embarques e entender impactos de possíveis atrasos nos recebimentos e lidar com o Controle de Qualidade (processos, interface loja, com a marca e solicitar os devidos reembolsos);
  • Participar e contribuir em ações da marca (como eventos etc), garantindo excelência e ganho de conhecimento;
  • Garantir acuracidade nas informações quantitativas e qualitativas, na frequência demandada, dos relatórios e calls com as marcas, garantindo repasse de informação sobre nosso negocio;
  • Capacidade de trabalhar em um ambiente ágil e dinâmico com altas demandas;
  • Disponibilidade para viajar internacionalmente para os markets das marcas - frequência de 1x por semestre.

Sobre a Engenharia de Dados:

Somos a área responsável pela coleta, tratamento, organização e disponibilização dos dados nas soluções e API da Neoway, bem como manter a sustentação desses dados. Nossos times estão organizados de acordo com o contexto de negócio de cada pacote de dados que sustentamos. Estes times são compostos por uma coordenação técnica, responsável por fazer a ponte entre os times de dados e o time de negócio, e pessoas Engenheiras de Dados, responsáveis pelo desenvolvimento e configuração de todas as etapas do fluxo da operação e produção de dados.

Requisitos e qualificações

Para desenvolver tudo isso contamos que você possua/ou esteja a fim de aprender os conhecimentos abaixo:

Seguimos práticas básicas de desenvolvimento:

  • Testes unitários, integração, e em alguns casos, sistema.

Nela temos as definições de inputs e outputs, regras de negócio e resultados esperados. A especificação técnica fica sob responsabilidade do desenvolvedor que tem total abertura para decidir a melhor forma de desenvolvimento em conjunto com os demais colegas de time.

description:

This role sits at the intersection of Sales, Services, and Systems, ensuring operational excellence across the full customer lifecycle. The ideal candidate is a systems thinker who thrives on process optimization, data accuracy, and cross-functional collaboration.

Our client provides a cloud-based ERP platform to hundreds of energy industry customers, delivering market-leading software solutions for field service management, field data gathering, transportation, production, accounting, and land management. Backed by private equity, our client accelerates business performance, improves operational efficiency, and reduces costs.

Responsibilities

  • Sales Operations

  • Partner with Sales Leadership to develop and maintain dashboards, metrics, and reports that provide visibility into bookings performance, funnel conversion, and forecast accuracy
  • Support commission plan execution by maintaining accurate opportunity data, product configurations, and close dates
  • Coordinate with Finance and Legal on deal review processes, ensuring consistency between quotes, contracts, and billing data
  • Services Operations

  • Track utilization, backlog, and project profitability metrics to ensure delivery teams have accurate performance visibility
  • Partner with the Project Management Office (PMO) and Delivery to standardize statements of work (SOWs), rate cards, and project milestone tracking

  • CRM and Systems Administration
  • Serve as the Salesforce (SFDC) administrator for all go-to-market (GTM) functions - including user management, profiles, validation rules, and custom workflows
  • Maintain integrations with related systems to ensure data synchronization and process automation
  • Implement enhancements and new functionality as business requirements evolve, documenting changes and training users accordingly
  • Manage user support requests, troubleshoot data discrepancies, and ensure compliance with data governance standards
  • Data and Reporting
  • Develop recurring and ad hoc reports to support revenue forecasting, KPI reviews, and board-level insights
  • Audit data for accuracy and completeness across systems; proactively resolve inconsistencies or bottlenecks
  • Partner with finance, sales, and marketing leadership to define and monitor core GTM metrics, including customer acquisition cost (CAC) payback, annual recurring revenue (ARR) growth, churn, and expansion rates.

Required Experience

  • Excellent English verbal and written skills
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, or a related field
  • 3 to 6 years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or similar analytical GTM roles
  • Advanced proficiency with Salesforce CRM

  • Strong Excel and reporting skills

  • Must be a self-starter and resourceful
  • Ability to work independently or as part of a team
  • Proven experience working effectively in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent

Desired Experience

  • Master of Business Administration degree
  • Salesforce administration certification
  • Familiarity with HubSpot, NetSuite, or PSA tools (e.g., Mavenlink, Kantata, FinancialForce)
  • Power BI or Tableau experience
  • Experience with oil and gas revenue accounting, gas processing, crude/gas/NGL transportation, or related fields

Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays

Procuramos um Arquiteto de Estratégia de Pessoas que não apenas gerencie, mas desenhe sistemas humanos de alto impacto. Se você é um designer de experiências , um evangelista de People Analytics e se sente frustrado com o RH focado em processos, este é o seu lugar.

Seu desafio será ir além dos ciclos anuais de performance e dos planos de treinamento prontos, construindo um Ecossistema de Crescimento que maximize a capacidade e a evolução contínua dos nossos talentos, utilizando dados para comprovar o valor de cada intervenção.

O Que Você Vai Desenhar (As Principais Entregas):

Aqui, o seu trabalho é transformar o como fazemos Pessoas:

  1. Arquitetura Preditiva do Talento: Saia do R&S reativo. Você vai projetar o Talent Sourcing usando IA e análise preditiva para antecipar as necessidades de habilidades futuras , construindo comunidades de talentos antes que a necessidade bata à porta.
  2. Design da Experiência do Colaborador (EX): Ser o Head Designer de toda a jornada. Desde o prospect até o alumnus , você garantirá que cada interação reforce nossa cultura de alto impacto .
  3. Cultura de Crescimento Contínuo: Evoluir a Performance de "avaliação cíclica" para um Modelo em Tempo Real . Você irá equipar a liderança com ferramentas de Micro-Coaching para focarem na evolução diária das skills , não apenas na nota final.
  4. Ecossistema de Aprendizagem Líquida (LXP): Acabar com o "Plano Anual de T&D". Você desenhará um LXP Personalizado e Just-in-Time , usando dados para mapear Skill Gaps e prover upskilling e reskilling imediatos.
  5. Organização Baseada em Habilidades: Mudar o foco de "cargos" para "capacidades". Você substituirá a Matriz de Competências estática por um Mapa Dinâmico de Habilidades , desenhando sistemas de Mobilidade Interna para alocar talentos flexivelmente em projetos críticos.
  6. Consultoria em Design Organizacional (OD): Atuar como consultor estratégico para a alta liderança.

O Que Esperamos de Você (Seu DNA de Arquiteto):

  • Visão de Arquiteto e Pensamento Sistêmico: Você vê o RH como um sistema interconectado , e não como silos de R&S, T&D e DP.
  • Empatia Algorítmica: Você tem uma cultura analítica forte e usa dados ( People Analytics Avançado ) não para controlar, mas para personalizar e humanizar a experiência em escala.
  • Storyteller de Dados: Sua habilidade em negociar e influenciar a alta liderança é superior, traduzindo insights complexos de dados em narrativas de impacto no negócio.
  • Inovação e Lean HR : Você tem coragem para experimentar com rapidez e baixa fidelidade ( testar e aprender ) e abandonar o que não funciona (Gestão de Mudança).

Requisitos Técnicos Essenciais (Seu Kit de Ferramentas):

  • Domínio de Design de Experiência do Colaborador (EX Design) e Design Thinking aplicados ao RH.
  • Conhecimento avançado em People Analytics (modelagem preditiva) e visualização de dados.
  • Proficiência em metodologias ágeis de Performance ( OKR, Feedback Contínuo ) e Gestão de Mudança Organizacional (PROSCI ou similar) .
  • Conhecimento prático em Design Organizacional (OD) ou Organizational Network Analysis (ONA) é um grande diferencial .

Formação & Certificações Chave:

  • Ensino Superior Completo.
  • Diferencial de Vanguarda: Certificação em Organizational Design (OD) , Behavioral Science ou Coaching de Liderança .

Se você é uma pessoa que está pronta para ir além do operacional e desenhar o futuro da organização, queremos te conhecer. Candidate-se e venha construir nosso ecossistema de talentos.

title: Casting Coordinator
description:
As Blueclip, we started our journey to bring the most creative minds and the know-how together to deliver great works.

About Our Search

We are currently looking for a Casting Coordinator to join our client, a global content company with a focus on talent sourcing for dynamic content projects.

What are we looking for?

  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field or equivalent experience.
  • 2+ years of experience in casting, story production, or talent interviewing.
  • Strong communication skills in English.
  • Proficiency with various casting resources and familiarity with social media platforms like TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, and Twitch.
  • High attention to detail and the ability to work efficiently under tight deadlines.
  • Organized, self-motivated, and capable of handling multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment.
  • Positive attitude with flexibility to adapt to last-minute changes and cancellations.
  • Experience with casting databases and familiarity with Monday.com and Google Suite.

What will you do?

This role offers a unique opportunity to contribute to talent sourcing and casting across innovative content projects.

  • Identify and source emerging talent across social media platforms, staying on top of trends.
  • Post-casting calls aligned with creative outlines for new and ongoing productions.
  • Screen, organize, and categorize auditions, preparing submissions for producer review.
  • Coordinate auditions with talent, agencies, and managers, managing the talent booking process.
  • Maintain a robust casting database with accurate records and updated talent profiles.
  • Collaborate with Performance Managers to validate profiles, negotiate terms, and align schedules.
  • Produce and direct assigned content episodes, ensuring alignment with strategy, budget, and creative goals.
  • Hosting the episodes on Youtube, being on camera as an interviewer.
  • Build strong relationships with the talent to foster positive creative collaborations and ensure smooth productions.
  • Track deadlines, legal requirements, and production specifications for timely and cost-effective delivery.

Are you ready to make an impact in content creation? Apply now with your English CV !

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
We’re Flowmentum and our clients are fast-moving teams building reliable, scalable, and secure infrastructure for companies shaping the future of AI, fintech, cloud services, and beyond.

Our engineers work on high-traffic, mission-critical systems that power millions of users across the globe.

We believe in autonomy, ownership, and solving hard problems — at scale. If you’re passionate about infrastructure done right, we want you on the team.

What You’ll Do:

  • Design and deploy cloud-native systems on AWS , that just work — at scale.
  • Own Kubernetes clusters : architecture, automation, observability, and performance tuning.
  • Build Terraform modules and GitOps pipelines to make deployments boring (in a good way).
  • Create CI/CD pipelines that are fast, reliable, and get new features into production safely.
  • Automate everything — provisioning, monitoring, security — with the best tools for the job.
  • Push systems to 99.99% uptime across billions of transactions a year.
  • Partner directly with product engineers, security, and leadership to ship infrastructure that accelerates growth.
  • Mentor teammates, review pull requests, and help define best practices as we scale.

You Should Have:

  • 7+ years of experience in DevOps , Cloud Engineering , or Site Reliability Engineering .
  • Strong Proven track record with LAMP ( Linux Apache Mysql PHP)
  • Strong real-world experience with AWS , Kubernetes , and Terraform .
  • A deep understanding of Linux, containers, networking, and cloud-native security.
  • Proven ability to scale systems to handle high-volume , high-availability workloads.
  • Hands-on skills in scripting or coding — Python , Go , or Bash are all great.
  • An eye for automation and eliminating manual work wherever you find it.
  • Startup or growth-stage experience (bonus points).
  • Excellent async communication skills (Slack, GitHub, Docs).

Bonus Points If You’ve:

  • Built infrastructure for AI/ML systems, SaaS, or telco-scale apps.
  • Used tools like GitHub Actions , ArgoCD , Vault , Elastic Stack , or EKS .
  • Led technical teams or been a mentor for junior engineers.
  • Got certifications like AWS Solutions Architect, CKA, or Azure Admin.

title: Service Technician
description:

Responsibility:

  1. Participate in various training organized by technical service department to improve technical ability and comprehensive service ability.
  2. Responsible for the plan suggestion or formulation of subsidiary stock spare parts.
  3. Submit the summary of machine quality problems in the responsible area and put forward suggestions for machine quality improvement.
  4. Responsible for assisting other colleagues of the subsidiary to complete the on-site inventory of spare parts warehouse of the subsidiary.
  5. Follow all company and customer safety policies.
  6. Install, repair, and maintain Injection Molding Machinery, linear robot, hopper dryer, auto-load, chiller, and related software, and control systems.
  7. Perform all safety checks on the equipment.
  8. Follow all of the company's procedures.
  9. Demonstrate the use of the equipment, and provide customer training.
  10. Troubleshoot machine failures and performance issues (Define service problem, collect data, establish facts, draw valid conclusions) and perform root cause analysis, and corrective actions. Document findings and actions.
  11. Order replacement parts as required and document other worn parts which may need replaced in the future.
  12. Respond quickly to customer problems via phone, email, or onsite in a prompt, courteous and professional way.
  13. Provide maintenance and operation recommendations or on-site service to customers.
  14. Provide written reports on all service calls, making sure to document key contacts, and the workload of the machines.
  15. Provide after-sales service and technical training for customers and agents, including but not limited to equipment safety, operation, maintenance, plastic raw materials and molding process training.
  16. Translate service files into local languages if necessary.

Requirements:

1.Education:

- College or bachelor degree;

- Major in mechanical manufacturing, electric engineering, automation or plastic material or equal;

- Other education background but more than 3 years’ experience in injection molding machine design, after-sales service or maintenance.

2.Background：

- 2 years service work or technical support work experience in injection molding machine industry or related industry.

3.Abilities：

- Ability to communicate in English;

- Ability to drive car;

- Extensive knowledge in the trouble shooting and repairing of injection molding machines, covering all aspects including controls, mechanical, hydraulic and electrical systems;

- Ability to use computers, email systems, basic Microsoft Office Excel, Word and Powerpoint;

- Ability to understand mechanical drawings, electrical and hydraulic schematics.

title: Game Operations Analyst/Senior Analyst (Graduated from 2022-2025)
description:
About Garena:

Established in 2009 and headquartered in Singapore , Garena is a leading online games developer and publisher with a global footprint across more than 130 markets.

Garena provides global users access to popular and engaging mobile and PC online games that it develops, curates, and localizes. It champions games as a social and entertainment platform on which its communities can engage and interact.

In addition, Garena is a leading esports organizer. It hosts esports events around the world that range from grassroots local tournaments to some of the most viewed professional esports competitions globally. The Free Fire World Series 2021 Singapore, which was watched by 5.4 million concurrent viewers at its peak, holds the record for the highest concurrent viewership of any esports match in history.

Main Responsibility

Support the strategy and performance of digital game operations, ensuring an excellent player experience while contributing to product evolution and monetization.

Job Description

  • Assist in analyzing player behavior and game performance to suggest improvements in retention, engagement, and monetization.
  • Collaborate on planning in-game events, update cycles, and monetization strategies.
  • Monitor real-time data to identify optimization opportunities.
  • Work alongside product, marketing, and support teams to ensure smooth operations and timely content delivery.
  • Create reports and dashboards tracking key metrics.
  • Research industry benchmarks to support strategic decisions.
  • Present insights and recommendations to internal teams, turning data into actionable strategies across departments.

Our Ideal Candidate

You are a driven and resilient professional who thrives in fast-paced environments and complex challenges. You bring:

  • Passion: A deep enthusiasm for gaming and a fearless curiosity to explore new ideas and territories.
  • Aptitude: A natural ability to quickly learn and master new skills, tools, and methodologies.
  • Drive: Unwavering commitment to overcoming obstacles and pushing boundaries to achieve your goals.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's/Master's degree completed or expected between December 2022 and December 2025 in Engineering, Business, Marketing, Digital Games or other fields
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English
  • Able to work in São Paulo, SP (Hybrid: 3 days in-office, 2 days remote)
  • Able to work in a full-time position (8 hours per day)
  • Passionate about games
  • Knowledge in Microsoft Office and/or Google Workspace (Word/Docs, Excel/Sheets, PowerPoint/Slides)

Why Join Us

Join a dynamic team where you will be directly involved in high-impact strategic projects that shape the future of our games and brand. Benefit from personalized mentorship and continuous learning opportunities through close collaboration with our experienced management team. Your creativity and insights will truly matter in an environment that prioritizes your professional growth.

title: Field Senior Account Sales Engineer
description:
Company Overview:

Cognex is the world’s leading provider of vision systems, software, sensors, and industrial barcode readers used in manufacturing automation. Cognex vision helps companies improve product quality, eliminate production errors, lower manufacturing costs, and exceed consumer expectations for high quality products at an affordable price. Typical applications for machine vision include detecting defects, monitoring production lines, guiding assembly robots, and tracking, sorting and identifying parts.

Cognex serves an international customer base from offices located throughout the Americas, Europe, and Asia, and through a global network of integration and distribution partners. The company is headquartered close to Boston in Natick, Massachusetts, USA.

Cognex is a financially strong international company with a culture that maintains the fast-paced, creative environment of a startup. Its employees, proudly called “Cognoids,” take their work seriously, but don't take themselves seriously. Their ‘Work Hard, Play Hard, Move Fast’ culture recognizes employees for their innovation, perseverance & hard work in a fun & rewarding environment. Cognex values in-person team collaboration, whilst offering remote workplace flexibility up to two days a week depending on the role.

Essential Functions:

  • Properly forecast and close vision solutions opportunities with End Users, Partners, and OEMs to reach the quota goal.
  • Utilize the Cognex sales process to effectively demonstrate products to customers and winning large strategic opportunities.
  • Follows up on sales leads and schedules customer visits, seeking out large opportunities.
  • Effectively conducts customer visits in a solution sales environment.
  • Collaborate with counterparts from other territories on opportunities that are either integrated or installed in a different territory or where the decision makers do not reside in the Account Manager’s territory.
  • Follow up on customer inquiries, understand system requirements, and differentiate the Cognex solution.
  • Assists at trade shows and other marketing events.
  • Coordinate evaluations utilizing the Applications Engineering team.
  • Maintain and continuously update project information in Sales Book.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

  • Proven track record of sales performance in the automation or similar industry.
  • Proven track record of operating in a solutions sales environment.
  • Uses defined sales process to deliver desired results on a consistent basis.
  • PC literate with a working knowledge of MS Windows applications.
  • Ability to travel 40% of the time is required.
  • Ability to work independently is required.

Minimum education and work experience required:

  • Technical Degree or equivalent work experience.
  • Proven sales experience and a good track record for exceeding sales targets is required.
  • Experience in selling technical products to all levels of an organization is required.
  • Experience in selling vision products is also preferred.

title: Senior AI Engineer (Python / Node.js)
description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior AI Engineer with 5+ years of software and AI/ML engineering experience. Candidates must have a strong background in Python and either Golang, Node.js, or Java expertise, with a strong desire to adopt Golang as the primary back-end technology.

In this position, you will be at the heart of the client's product innovation, responsible for designing, implementing, and operationalizing AI-native services that transform the utility sector. This role combines applied AI/ML expertise with strong back-end engineering skills, ensuring the client's agentic systems are not only functional but scalable, secure, and production-ready.

As a key member of our engineering team, you will report directly to the CTO and operate within small, agile teams alongside software engineers, security experts, and product managers. You will own the full lifecycle of AI services from data ingestion and model training to real-time deployment and monitoring while continuously adapting to evolving requirements in a fast-moving, high-stakes industry.

Our client is building an AI-centric operating system for utilities. It harnesses AI at the enterprise level to better orchestrate customer delight, facilitate power optimization, improve the health of the grid, and unlock flexibility at scale. Funded by a strategic industry partner and one of the founders at Groupon, the client is poised to transform how utilities run and how customers experience energy.

Responsibilities

  • AI Systems Development : Architect, fine-tune, and deploy AI agents purpose-built for utility use cases, including predictive operations, customer engagement, and energy optimization
  • Back-End Integration : Build APIs, microservices, and orchestration frameworks that seamlessly connect AI models with enterprise systems and grid-level data flows
  • Pipeline Ownership : Design and manage the complete AI pipeline ingestion, embeddings, retrieval, evaluation, and continuous deployment, ensuring reliability and scalability
  • AI Risk Mitigation : Address vulnerabilities unique to AI, such as model drift, bias exploitation, adversarial robustness, and hallucination control with sensitivity to regulated environments
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration : Partner with software engineers, data specialists, and security teams to integrate AI capabilities into the broader client OS, embedding AI by design into every product release
  • Speed of Delivery : Operate with urgency, delivering breakthroughs in code and AI services on cycles measured in weeks, not quarters.

Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of applied ML/AI engineering experience, ideally with exposure to enterprise/mission-critical systems.
  • Strong proficiency in Python and either Golang, Node.js, or Java (non-Golang developers will learn and adopt Golang on the job)
  • Expertise with ML/LLM frameworks, such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, LangChain, or equivalent
  • Experience with vector databases, orchestration frameworks, and modern MLOps practices.
  • Track record of deploying AI services in production
  • Strong grounding in cloud-native architectures (AWS, GCP, Azure)
  • Analytical, collaborative, and comfortable with ambiguity.
  • Ability to thrive in small, high-velocity teams, balancing experimentation with production rigor

Desired Experience

  • University degree or relevant industry experience
  • Experience working on ERP systems or within the power utilities industry

Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture, share knowledge, be inclusive, learn, and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

Descrição Breve do Cargo:

  • Acompanhamento social aos colaboradores de ocorrências de trabalho;
  • Articular o processo de consultas, exames e procedimentos cirúrgicos dos mesmos;
  • Auxiliar familiares de colaboradores em caso de óbito;
  • Montar e acompanhar o processo de seguro de vida;

Instrução:

Requisitos Necessários:

  • Conhecimento em Sistemas Corporativos;
  • Domínio de elaboração de relatórios e pareceres sociais;
  • Conhecimento da plataforma do INSS;

  • Cursos de Aperfeiçoamento: Capacitação em Legislação Trabalhista e Previdenciária, Noções básicas de Normas Regulamentadoras (NRs) aplicadas à saúde e segurança no trabalho.
  • Residir em Tailândia e entorno.

Competências éticas:

  • Sigilo profissional e postura ética conforme o Código de Ética do Assistente Social.
  • Boa comunicação com colaboradores e equipe multiprofissional.

Sobre a Agropalma

A Agropalma é uma empresa brasileira reconhecida em todo o mundo como referência na produção sustentável de soluções com óleo de palma. Sua trajetória começou em 1982, no município de Tailândia (PA), e sua atuação perfaz toda a cadeia produtiva – da fabricação de mudas ao óleo refinado e gorduras especiais às soluções de alto valor agregado, incluindo produtos orgânicos. Atualmente, a companhia conta com seis indústrias de extração de óleo bruto, duas refinarias e um terminal de exportação alfandegado, e emprega cerca de 5 mil colaboradores. A Agropalma também foi pioneira em implementar, há mais de 20 anos, um programa de Agricultura Familiar com palma, que beneficia hoje mais de 300 agricultores parceiros. Guiada pelo compromisso com o planeta e as pessoas, a empresa segue avançando em suas práticas para tornar a palma sustentável uma referência brasileira. Para mais informações, acesse: .

description:

Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.

description:
Join NFQ!

We are a global consulting firm specialized in business, technology, and operations, with over 2,000 professionals across national and international offices. At NFQ, we offer a different consulting model: Flexible | Scalable | Specialized | Client-Centric .

As part of our continuous growth, we are looking for a Senior Consultant / Manager – Asset Management to join our team in Brazil. title: NetSuite Accountant
description:
Staff Accountant (Remote) – USA Clients

Location: Remote – Brazil

Salary: USD 1,700/month

Schedule: 40 hours/week

About Us

We are a dynamic and growing U.S.-based accounting firm specializing in providing financial services across a wide range of industries. Our team is composed of highly skilled professionals who are passionate about delivering exceptional results and building long-term client relationships. TGG Accounting is growing, and we’re looking for a Staff Accountant with NetSuite experience and strong process enhancement and implementation skills to join our remote team. If you're detail-oriented and passionate about financial reporting, budgeting, and variance analysis, this is your chance to work with top-tier US clients.

MIT — Most Important Thing

The Staff Accountant is responsible for following the TGG Way standards for processing and implementing the day-to-day transactional accounting to produce complete and accurate financial statements. The Staff Accountant is required to build and maintain positive relationships with clients, clients’ staff, co-workers, and managers. Understanding source documents, inputting them, and filing them correctly is a key part of the Staff Accountant’s job. Using critical thinking and having a proficiency in intermediate accounting, the Staff Accountant is responsible for the accurate data entry of all transactions into the accounting system.

Responsibilities

  • Accounts Payable & Receivable: Processing invoices, applying payments, and reconciling transactions accurately and efficiently.
  • Bank & Credit Card Reconciliations: Performing soft reconciliations weekly and hard reconciliations monthly, ensuring accuracy in coding and matching transactions. Reconcile bank accounts, credit cards, and intercompany accounts in NetSuite .
  • Month-End Workbooks: Preparing and reconciling schedules for various accounts such as AR, AP, payroll accruals, loans, and fixed assets. Execute timely and accurate month-end close processes under tight deadlines.
  • Financial Reporting: Mapping accounts, syncing data, and generating financial reports using TGG templates. Analyze and review month-over-month income statements, making necessary adjustments (e.g., prepaid expenses, accrued expenses, fixed assets, and managing cash flow).
  • NetSuite: Utilize NetSuite for bank feeds, reconciliations, accounts payable and receivable processing, generating reports, and posting journal entries. This includes running balance sheets and profit & loss reports, entering invoices and bills, and creating customers and vendors.
  • Communication and Task Management: Using Asana to update and manage tasks and Bizinta for time entries with detailed descriptions.

Requirements

  • 2–3 years of accounting or finance experience doing month-end close processes, bank reconciliations, and intercompany transactions.
  • Education: Accounting or Finance degree preferred.
  • Technical Knowledge: Strong proficiency in NetSuite (or similar ERP) and Excel.
  • Strong background in process enhancement, process implementation, and system optimization.
  • Communication: Fluent in English, both written and spoken, with excellent attention to detail and analytical skills.
  • Strong understanding of debits/credits, journal entries, and accrual-based accounting.
  • US GAAP knowledge required; IFRS familiarity is a plus.
  • Experience working with European entities is a plus.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating with a remote team.
  • Working Equipment to start is required.
  • Working hours based on client

Perks & Benefits

  • Unlimited PTO Policy, including all Holidays.
  • 1 Month of Paid training in advanced accounting, U.S. GAAP, and NetSuite.
  • Full access to TGG University and learning materials.
  • Career development through mentoring, training, and long-term growth opportunities.

About TGG Accounting

At TGG Accounting, our mission is to make business owners’ lives better through excellent financial management. We provide outsourced accounting and advisory services to small and mid-size businesses, helping them build strong financial foundations, plan for growth, and make better decisions.

We are more than 250 teammates, located across the U.S. and around the world in the Philippines, Argentina, Ecuador, Chile, Brazil, Peru, and Mexico, working together in a vibrant, multicultural environment to deliver on our mission.

Our Core Values

  • Loyalty
  • Integrity
  • Strong Work Ethic
  • Forward Thinking – Growth Mindset
  • Team Player / Caring / Selfless
  • Positive Energy – People who have fun, smile, and laugh
  • Freedom & Accountability

title: Coordenador(a) de Suprimentos - Suporte a Compras
description:
O Projeto Sucuriú marca a entrada da divisão de celulose da Arauco no Brasil. O investimento de US$4.6 bilhões inclui a construção de uma planta com capacidade de produção de 3,5 milhões de toneladas de fibra curta de celulose/ano. Está localizado em uma área de 3.500 hectares, a 50 quilômetros do centro da cidade de Inocência (MS) e ao lado do Rio Sucuriú. A etapa de terraplanagem começou em 2024 e a previsão de entrada em operação é no final de 2027.

Em todas as fases desenvolvimento do Projeto, e de maneira contínua, monitora e respeita a biodiversidade local, identificando espécies de flora e fauna nativas da região, além de fazer o mapeamento das áreas prioritárias para conservação.

Durante as obras, a Arauco vai oferecer capacitação e gerar mais de 14 mil oportunidades de trabalho. Depois do start up , o Projeto Sucuriú empregará cerca de 6 mil pessoas nas unidades Industrial, Florestal e operações de Logística. O propósito é impulsionar o desenvolvimento social e econômico para toda região, fomentando um aumento na geração de renda e na arrecadação de impostos, além de contribuir para atrair investimentos.

Sobre a Arauco Brasil

No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras.

As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose brasileira em Inocência (MS).

Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.

Desafio

Coordenar o time de Suprimentos - Suporte a Compras, nas atividades de elaboração, definição, manutenção e divulgação de políticas e procedimentos, cadastro e homologação de fornecedores, metas e indicadores de desempenho, orçamento, inteligência em compras, atendimento a auditorias, otimizando recursos, custos e assegurando a eficiência da equipe de Suprimentos e da Arauco Celulose Brasil.

tividades principais

Como se candidatar:

O termo Conforme + Dominante vem do teste comportamental DISC , que classifica o comportamento das pessoas em quatro perfis principais:

  • D – Dominância
  • I – Influência
  • S – Estabilidade
  • C – Conformidade

No caso, “ Conforme + Dominante ” significa que a pessoa tem predominância nas características de Conformidade (C) , mas também apresenta traços de Dominância (D) .

Isso gera um perfil que normalmente é:

Conforme (C) – Característica principal

  • Extremamente organizada
  • Segue processos e padrões
  • Atenta a detalhes
  • Gosta de fazer certo da primeira vez
  • Preocupada com qualidade e precisão

Dominante (D) – Característica secundária

  • Decidida e assertiva
  • Focada em resultados
  • Não tem medo de assumir responsabilidades
  • Capaz de tomar decisões rápidas
  • Sabe cobrar e manter prazos

Você é daquelas pessoas que ama conversar, conectar e transformar vidas ?

Então talvez você tenha nascido pra estar aqui com a gente.

A Smile University é uma escola de negócios para dentistas.

Transformamos clínicas em empresas lucrativas por meio de conteúdo, mentorias e uma cultura brutalmente verdadeira.

Estamos crescendo. E queremos você com a gente.

✨ Sua missão como SDR será:
  • Abrir conversas com leads que demonstraram interesse nos nossos produtos (nada de ligação fria!)
  • Qualificar esses leads com profundidade e verdade (usamos SPIN e escuta ativa de verdade)
  • Marcar reuniões com nossos closers e manter o CRM atualizado
  • Gerar conexão humana, mesmo por WhatsApp, ligação ou mensagem de voz
  • Trabalhar com ritmo , verdade e coração no jogo todos os dias
O que esperamos de você:
  • Fome de aprendizado e sede de crescimento
  • Facilidade em se comunicar com leveza, verdade e presença
  • Organização e compromisso com metas diárias
  • Vontade de crescer comercialmente – o céu não é o limite, é o começo
  • Familiaridade com tecnologia (WhatsApp Web, CRM, planilhas, etc.)
Modelo de contratação:
  • CLT Presencial – Curitiba/PR
O que oferecemos:
  • Vale alimentação + VT ou auxílio mobilidade
  • Plano de saúde Unimed após experiência
  • Treinamentos semanais e mentoria comercial real (com quem vive o campo de batalha)
  • Possibilidade real de crescimento interno
  • Um time que joga junto, cresce junto e se importa de verdade
Importante:

Aqui na Smile, a gente acredita em fazer o que precisa ser feito, sem mimimi .

Se você busca um lugar pra crescer com verdade, entrega e ritmo – vem jogar com a gente.

Quer participar?

Clique no botão "Candidatar-se" e conte, em poucas linhas, por que você quer essa vaga.

Estamos te esperando.

  • Com brilho no olho e coração no jogo.

description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

We are looking for (job name) who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will: (responsibilities)

Overview

The SAP AMS Project Manager is responsible for managing the delivery of SAP Application Management Services across multiple modules and business areas. This role oversees incident, problem, change, and enhancement management, ensuring compliance with SLAs, high-quality service delivery, and alignment with business objectives. The SAP AMS Project Manager also drives continuous improvement, governance, and customer satisfaction in a global delivery model.

Key Responsibilities

Service & Project Delivery

Manage day-to-day SAP AMS operations, including incident, problem, change, and service request management.

Oversee delivery of SAP enhancements, small projects, and rollouts within agreed timelines and budgets.

Ensure SLAs, KPIs, and service quality targets are consistently achieved.

Coordinate with SAP Basis, Functional, and Technical teams to resolve issues and deliver solutions.

Drive root cause analysis and preventive measures to reduce recurring incidents.

Stakeholder & Client Management

Act as the primary contact for clients regarding SAP AMS delivery.

Facilitate regular status, governance, and steering committee meetings.

Build and maintain strong business stakeholder relationships across Finance, Supply Chain, and other SAP domains.

Translate business priorities into SAP AMS delivery plans.

Team & Vendor Coordination

Manage onshore/offshore AMS delivery teams across SAP modules (FI, CO, MM, SD, PP, etc.).

Allocate resources and track performance of functional and technical consultants.

Collaborate with third-party vendors for specialized SAP services (e.g., Cloud, S/4HANA, integrations).

Governance, Reporting & Financials

Prepare and deliver monthly/quarterly service performance reports.

Track AMS budgets, contract compliance, and cost optimization initiatives.

Identify and escalate risks/issues with mitigation strategies.

Continuous Improvement & Innovation

Recommend SAP process improvements and automation opportunities.

Support migration, upgrades, or transition projects (e.g., ECC to S/4HANA).

Drive adoption of ITIL best practices, Agile, or DevOps in SAP AMS delivery.

Qualifications & Skills

Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Business, or related field.

7+ years of experience in SAP project/AMS management.

Strong knowledge of SAP modules (FI, CO, MM, SD, PP, etc.) and integration points.

Experience with ITIL processes (Incident, Problem, Change, Release Management).

Proven track record in managing global/onshore-offshore delivery models.

Excellent client-facing and stakeholder management skills.

PMP, ITIL, or SAP certifications (SAP Solution Manager, Activate, S/4HANA) preferred.

Key Competencies

Deep understanding of SAP AMS operating model.

Strong leadership and team coordination skills.

Analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making ability.

Customer-first mindset with service excellence orientation.

Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously.

title: Engenheiro de controle
description:
About Woodgrove

We are a leading provider of energy efficient, innovative equipment, instrumentation, and process control systems to the global mining industry. With companies in Brazil, Chile, Mexico, and South Africa, Woodgrove has built a reputation based on quality, performance, and safety. The company is entrepreneurial, dynamic and our team are driven to succeed. We are looking for like-minded individuals that want to be part of a transformational business.

Role Summary

This role is for a position within the Advanced Process Control (APC) department. The APC department works with mine sites around the world (both remotely and on site) to deploy and integrate optimization solutions for the benefit of clients and industry. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys travelling and has an analytical mind.

All resumes must be in english.

Responsibilities

  • Development, deployment, and integration of Advanced Regulatory Control applications
  • Support deployment and integration of Expert Systems
  • Analyze and troubleshoot control system issues and provide solutions to improve system performance and reliability.
  • Experience commissioning and tuning of control systems.
  • Produce technical documentation (e.g., reports, manuals, specifications, drawings)
  • Conduct data analyses.
  • Verification and validation of software through inspection, simulation, and testing
  • Work with cross-functional teams to develop and implement control systems for new projects.
  • Perform regular reviews and upgrades on existing control systems to ensure optimal performance.
  • Ensure compliance with safety regulations and industry standards.

Qualifications/Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Control and Automation Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field
  • English: intermediate, conversation level
  • Extensive experience in a control engineering project environment
  • Knowledge and axperience with multiple control systems, including PLCs, SCADA systems, and DCS systems (ABB, DeltaV, Siemens, Rockwell, Schneider, Honeywell, etc.)
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to troubleshoot control systems.
  • Proficiency with programming languages such as Ladder Logic, Function Block Diagram, and Structured text
  • Strong written, communication and interpersonal skills
  • Familiarity with industry standards and regulations related to control systems.

title: Senior Project Manager
description:
As THE leader in transit technology, Clever Devices' vision is to make meaningful contributions to worldwide mobility. Our goal is to be the leading provider of exciting technology that improves the quality of mobility in communities around the world.

The Senior Project Manager is a transit industry veteran with a proven track record for leading the design, development, and implementation of Transit ITS projects. A dynamic leader, with excellent communications, interpersonal skills, acknowledged industry experience, the Senior Project Manager is responsible for leading project teams, managing resources, adherence to schedule performance, and managing the financials of projects throughout the full development life cycle. This also includes management of issues, risks, and project change requests to ensure successful and on-time project delivery.

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Manage all aspects of a project, including planning, organization, and implementation of project activities, ensuring projects are managed in line with scope, budget, schedule, and quality standards
  • Provide overall project communication to stakeholders and meet project requirements and stakeholder expectations
  • Serves as primary point of contact with the customer of the project and keeps customer appraised of project progress
  • Manage and oversee all project activities, such as issue tracking and risk mitigation, facilitating project team meetings and preparing/delivering status reports
  • Work closely with cross functional departments (Deployment, Engineering Design, Installation, and Field Service) to ensure successful execution of projects
  • Established a working relationship with the customer’s stakeholders and maintains good communication correspondence with customer.
  • Assembles appropriate team to meet and exceed project expectations
  • Provide direction and control of work performed in the framework of project, including monitoring the critical path and implementation of appropriate corrective actions
  • Coordinate and perform review of the project deliverables, software and hardware, and report on project performance
  • Manage and plan with the Systems Engineering and Product/Engineering team leads for technical review of system design and documentation with the customer
  • Establishes a project plan and schedules according to established company practices, polices, tools and templates.
  • Establishes milestones and monitors adherence to program master plans
  • Manages financial schedule performance of assigned projects
  • Maintains and keeps scheduling of assigned projects and communicates schedule changes as necessary
  • Manages full lifecycle of project and ensures each aspect of the project is completed
  • Manages procurement of equipment and materials necessary to execute on projects
  • Develops subcontractors’ scopes of work, executes subcontracts and manages subcontractors as may be necessary
  • Coordinates with Sales and Account Managers to further sales opportunities
  • May coordinate proposal preparation, including standards of work and specifications, estimation of product and service costs.
  • May participate in negotiation and administration of contracts
  • Travel required for onsite at customers facility up to 40%
  • Adheres to company processes and policies.

Skills Required:

  • 10+ years’ experience as a Project Manager in a technical or engineering environment with a focus on delivering projects to external customers.
  • B.S. Degree and or 5+ Years as a Project Manager in and ITS environment
  • PMP certification or equivalent preferred.
  • Experience in transit industry.
  • Strong computer skills, including MS Office Suite, Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook as well as ability to learn new software programs such as Microsoft Dynamics AX
  • Strong team building and leadership skills. Ability to lead the team.
  • Strong organizational skills
  • Strong problem-solving skills
  • Strong analytical skills
  • Strong time management skills and ability to handle multiple tasks simultaneously
  • Strong verbal and written communications, presentation, and persuasive skills
  • Strong interpersonal skills
  • Strong negotiation and influence skills
